name: null-activity
description: Private, local-only coding activity tracking for Null IDE — active time, projects, languages and sessions

commands.title: Null Activity: Delete Tracked Data for a Range…
Null Activity: Delete All Tracked Data…
Null Activity: Publish Badges to a Gist…
Null Activity: Save Badges as SVG…

null-activity.enabled.description: Track coding activity locally. Turning this off stops collection immediately; existing data stays until you delete it.

null-activity.idleTimeout.description: Seconds without interaction before time stops counting.

null-activity.sessionGap.description: Minutes of inactivity that end a session.

null-activity.badge.autoPublish.description: Refresh the published badge Gist about once an hour while Null IDE is open. Only updates a Gist you already published with "Publish Badges to a Gist"; sends your total coding time, daily average and top language to GitHub.

scripts.compile: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.webview-dashboard-shared.json && tsc -p tsconfig.webview-dashboard.json
scripts.test: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.webview-dashboard-shared.json && tsc -p tsconfig.webview-dashboard.json && node --test out/test/tracker.test.js out/test/stats.test.js out/test/intervalStore.test.js out/test/projectIdentity.test.js out/test/activityService.test.js out/test/privacy.test.js out/test/dashboardModel.test.js out/test/dashboardWebviewModel.test.js out/test/dashboardHtml.test.js out/test/gitLog.test.js out/test/gitStatsService.test.js out/test/gitStatsService.git.test.js out/test/badgeSvg.test.js out/test/badgeModel.test.js out/test/gistClient.test.js out/test/badgePublisher.test.js
